intro: The gateway's list, moved here from `../gateway/tasks.md` on 2026-10-12.

features.title: Add a code editor
features.description: Everywhere the UI shows a code or script fragment, show it in a code editor with syntax highlighting, e.g. the setup and teardown scripts of a stack's shared service.
today: editable, plain textareas: Provides › Setup and Teardown (`apps/web/src/stacks/form/shared-cards.tsx:179`, `:186`);
editable, already highlighted with CodeMirror, but the gateway's own: the inline Dockerfile (`apps/web/src/stacks/form/dockerfile-editor.tsx`);
read-only, already bh's `CodeBlock`: the Compose tab and the stack form's compose preview;
read-only, plain `<code>`: the agent token's `curl` example (`apps/web/src/settings/tokens-page.tsx:50`).
Logs (deploys, job runs, service logs) are output, not code: they're GW-11.

plan.title: Make a `@bh/code` package
plan.description: A package for everything code. `CodeBlock`, the highlighter (`SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHTER`, `highlightLines`) and its grammars move there from `@bh/markdown`, which then depends on `@bh/code` for its code block. `@bh/markdown` keeps exporting them, from `@bh/code`, and its sheet imports `@bh/code`'s, so an app's next update passes its checks before the app switches its imports. BH-15 (the blocks into `@bh/markdown`) is done (195df76), so nothing else moves these files. The docs site lists the package (Packages › Code), and the layers become config < form, table < ui < code < markdown, shell.

plan.title: Add `CodeEditor` to `@bh/code`
plan.description: Generalized from the gateway's `DockerfileEditor`: `value`, `onChange`, `lang`, a title strip with line count and Ln/Col, a min height, growing with its text (no scroll box of its own, GW-7), `readOnly`. It colors with `CodeBlock`'s highlighter. Languages: `shell`, `dockerfile`, `yaml`; `CodeBlock` also colors `sh` and `dockerfile`, so read-only fragments match the editor. With tests and a docs page, as every bh package has.

plan.title: Bring `@bh/code` into the gateway
plan.description: bh's commit pushed to its main makes a release (your yes). Then the gateway's bh page updates the gateway to it: the copy brings `@bh/code` with `@bh/markdown`, which needs it, runs the checks and commits `chore: bh <version>` to the gateway, whose push deploys it (your yes again). Then `CodeBlock` and `SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHTER` are imported from `@bh/code`.

plan.title: Edit the Dockerfile in `CodeEditor`
plan.description: The inline Dockerfile uses `CodeEditor lang="dockerfile"`; `dockerfile-editor.tsx` and the gateway's own `@codemirror/*` dependencies go.

plan.title: Edit Setup and Teardown in `CodeEditor`
plan.description: Both use `CodeEditor lang="shell"`.

plan.description: `CodeBlock lang="sh"`. The token itself stays plain: it's a value, not code.

features.title: Replace the gateway's own components with bh's
features.description: Wherever possible, use components from bh (`@bh/*`) instead of the gateway's own. A component bh lacks is added in `../bh` first and then synced, never edited under `packages/bh/`.

today.text: pages already use `@bh/shell`'s `Page`, `PageHeader`, `CardGrid`, and `@bh/ui`'s primitives (`Card`, `Button`, `Input`, `Pill`…). The gateway still keeps its own:
items: copies of what bh has now: `ThemeFooter` (`apps/web/src/app/theme-footer.tsx`; `@bh/shell` has one since), `Field` (`apps/web/src/stacks/form/fold.tsx`; `@bh/ui`'s `FieldWrapper`), the uppercase captions (`GROUP_LABEL`, `Figures`' title; `@bh/ui`'s `SectionHeader`);

generic parts bh lacks: the card parts (`apps/web/src/lib/card-parts.tsx`: `MetricCard`, `CardState`, `Meter`, `Figure`, `Figures`, `Num`), the folds (`Chevron`, `Section`, `FoldCard` in `fold.tsx`), `RouteTabs` (`apps/web/src/stacks/route-tabs.tsx`, because `@bh/shell`'s `TabNav` lights the first matching tab, not the longest, and shows no badges), and a link class copied into 9 files (`const LINK = 'text-gray-12 underline-offset-2 hover:underline'`);
hand-built controls: 11 raw `<button>`s in 9 files, one raw radio (`service-card.tsx:368`), one hand-made chip (`service-settings.tsx:128`).
medialib's dashboard has its own `CardState` and `Figures` too (`../medialib/apps/web/src/app/lib/card-state.tsx`): a second app, so those belong in bh.

features.stays: what knows the gateway (`StackLink`, `SaveBar`, `DockerfilePicker`, the pages and their cards), and the charts (`Sparkline`, `TimeChart`), which no other app has yet. The stack form stays hand-built from bh's primitives rather than moving to `@bh/form`: that would be a rewrite, not a swap. Covered elsewhere: `DockerfileEditor` (GW-1), the logs' `<pre>`s (GW-11), `TabBody` and page gutters (GW-3).

features.title: Move other apps' config out of Caddy
features.description: Caddy's stack shouldn't hold other apps' config: no site file or variable of another app in it. Each app holds its own names, by its stack's connection to Caddy.
today: Already out: wallet-passes' site file and `WALLET_PASSES_DOMAIN` (7cb44f2), the gateway's `gateway.caddy` (9374a72). docs, cv and wallet-passes hold their names as web addresses of their stacks, whose sites `config/site.sh` writes.

Left in Caddy's stack: medialib's `config/sites/media.caddy` and `MEDIA_DOMAIN` (a wildcard site `*.<media domain>` routing nine names, plex, radarr, sonarr, prowlarr, qbittorrent, seerr, bazarr, jellyfin, cleanuparr, to medialib's services, any other name a 404, and the bare name to its dashboard); and the gateway's page, by a temporary `@gateway host {$GATEWAY_DOMAIN}` rule in the wildcard site (`config/Caddyfile:47`), with `GATEWAY_DOMAIN`.
Caddy's own, so they stay: `ACME_CA`, `WILDCARDS` (the wildcard certificates it holds), and the two build versions, `CADDY_VERSION` and `CLOUDFLARE_DNS_VERSION` (`caddy/compose.yaml:22`).
